name: Henan Jinyuan Hydrogenated Chemicals Co., Ltd.
summary: Henan Jinyuan Hydrogenated Chemicals Co., Ltd. was established in 2012 and has its base in Jiyuan, China. It makes, processes, distributes and sells hydrogenated benzene-derived chemicals and energy products in China. Its chemicals include pure benzene, toluene and xylene, while its energy products include liquefied natural gas and coal gas.
